1.name: Bacterial Leaf Spot (Xanthomonas)
1.treatment: Isolate affected plot. Spray Streptomycin sulphate solution.
1.prevention: Use disease-resistant seeds for next planting cycle.

2.name: Early Blight (Alternaria solani)
2.treatment: Apply copper-based fungicide spray twice weekly.
2.prevention: Avoid overhead sprinkler watering; remove bottom infected leaves.
